messages:
Maya (AE): Aurelia Health wants the final POC handback this week. Need runbook for handing the env back: rotate hosted API keys, drain + teardown dedicated pool, confirm embeddings/data retention (they asked for 90d), snapshot logs. Who can own the steps?
Ethan (SRE): I can take the pool teardown. Which pool id?
Maya (AE): dp-eu-west-47
Ethan (SRE): Plan suggestion: 1) stop traffic, 2) drain for 2h, 3) snapshot metrics, 4) delete pool. Teardown commands I use:``` 
rwctl pools drain dp-eu-west-47 --wait 7200
rwctl pools delete dp-eu-west-47 --force
```
Ethan (SRE): Also export KV caches if we need a short rollback window.
Priya (Eng-Infra): Quick note: for Dedicated we should remove any internal NAT entries and confirm autoscaler disabled before delete. If VPC peering existed, remove routes after teardown.
Jordan (Security): Before we delete anything, we must rotate the hosted API key and create an audit artifact. Embeddings retention: by default 30 days, but customer requested 90 days — that needs explicit consent + SOW addendum or legal hold. Do not delete embeddings until legal confirms.
Luca (CS): Customer already agreed to 90d retention for POC in email thread; I'll upload the signed consent to the ticket. Also they asked us to snapshot logs to their S3 archive.
Maya (AE): OK owners: Mia rotate keys, Ethan pool teardown, Priya network, Jordan security sign-off, Luca customer comms. Mia — can you rotate keys and invalidate old tokens?
Mia (Ops): I can rotate at 2026-05-12 02:00 UTC. Command I'll run:```
redwood-api keys rotate --customer aurelia-poc --invalidate-old --audit-note "POC handback 2026-05-12"
```
Mia (Ops): I'll open ticket POC-4821 and tag audit logs.
Ethan (SRE): After teardown let's keep a 24h rollback snapshot (pool metadata + KV export) in internal bucket then purge. I'll prepare the export script.
Priya (Eng-Infra): Confirming this is Hosted API + Dedicated pool (not Private/VPC-only). If there had been private peering we'd need change control for route deletes.
Maya (AE): Correct — Hosted + Dedicated. Also customer asked for metrics snapshot to s3://redwood-poc-archives/aurelia/2026-05-12. Add that to runbook.
Jordan (Security): Also add the requirement: update customer-facing audit log showing key rotation event and the pre-delete retention statement. If legal hold needed, do not purge.
Ana (Finance): Noted on prorated credits for remaining dedicated capacity. Finance will process credit after teardown confirmation. Ticket: FIN-9876.
Luca (CS): I'll send the customer a timeline: key rotation 2026-05-12 02:00 UTC, pool drain same day 02:30 UTC, deletion after 4h unless rollback requested.
Maya (AE): Final runbook checklist I will create in the ticket: 1) confirm signed 90d consent (Luca) 2) rotate API keys (Mia) 3) stop traffic + notify teams (Maya) 4) drain pool (Ethan) 5) export metrics + KV (Ethan) 6) delete pool (Ethan) 7) remove networking (Priya) 8) confirm logs archived to S3 (Luca) 9) finance credit processed (Ana) 10) close ticket + audit (Jordan).
Priya (Eng-Infra): LGTM :thumbsup:
Ethan (SRE): On it.
Mia (Ops): Confirmed, will post updates in POC-4821.
Luca (CS): Messaging customer now.
Maya (AE): tagging @here — any objections to the 2026-05-12 timeline? If none I'll proceed to schedule.
(15:42) Jordan (Security): No objections from security side.
